All valid modeled sized payloads and supplied Default dictionaries; default features x86_64. Main contract is model-level branch/delegation for the complete abstract Default result. It assumes no particular Default value, success or termination. Rust Drop of discarded payloads may panic, diverge or affect external state and is outside this model; no Rust destructor/unwind/return guarantee is inferred. Separate selected-branch, conditional normal, model failure and divergence theorems are audited.
